meta.disclaimer: PILOT / reviewable classification. Nothing in this report is written to or derived from institutional_activities. Internal evidence spans are for validation/review only and are never public UI fields. No classification accuracy is claimed; a human-reviewed evaluation set does not yet exist.

dates.convention: academic_year uses the earliest EXPLICIT date only; June 1 - May 31. No invented dates; undated posts stay undated.

evidence_quality.note: evidence_score is an internal heuristic (category pattern weight sum + matched dept/stakeholder signals); it is NOT an accuracy metric.

review_sample_mark.accuracy_claim: NONE. Classifier behaviour must be evaluated by a human before any accuracy statement is allowed.
